blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — A group of law professors, former law deans, and current and former Integrated Bar of the Philippines (IBP) presidents in Eastern Visayas asked the Senate impeachment court to set the voting threshold in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte at 14, instead of 16. In a Sept. 17 letter to Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian, the group challenged Senate impeachment court presiding officer Francis Escudero’s ruling that 16 affirmative votes are needed for conviction The group said the constitutional requirement of a two-thirds vote of all Senate members should be based on senators who are actually sitting […]...
